inputs: Original background generation followed by edits of that generated background. No personal photo inputs.
prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a square original high-end swimming pool WATER BACKGROUND TEXTURE for a 720 by 720 device display, full bleed. The camera is perfectly vertical overhead, optical axis exactly perpendicular to the horizontal water surface, orthographic plan view. A deep sunlit turquoise-blue pool with a rich deep cobalt mosaic tile floor visible UNDER 1.5 to 2 meters of crystal clear water. Small irregular cyan and desaturated blue square ceramic tiles, realistic grout, luminous natural thin caustics refracting across tiles at different intensities and scales, brighter scintillation upper right and much deeper shadow on lower left. Strong convincing translucent WATER VOLUME and deep depth, complex organic sun refraction patterns, realistic local ripple distortions of the submerged tile grid, NO painted wavy squiggles or flat vector grid. Equal narrow blue tiled inner pool walls along all four edges, believable dark underwater contact shadow where walls meet deep floor. The center remains unobstructed water. Realistic materials, beautifully art directed, tactile and serene, natural high spatial detail but controlled contrast to support cream-colored circular data floats that will be overlaid later in code. No float rings, no people, no characters, no toys, no fish, no leaves, no text, no numbers, no clock, no logo, no watermark, no device frame, no perspective slant, no vanishing point, no horizon. Do not render any UI. Only the empty square pool background.

Edit this original pool texture for use as the background of a vertical-overhead device face. Preserve the perfectly vertical top-down composition and the square pool. Correct the current excessive darkness: make the water much clearer, brighter and lighter, pale aquamarine and clean sky blue ceramic mosaics with natural white grout visible through transparent water. Photographic clarity and light sunlit pool water, not deep cobalt or navy; remove checkerboard dark patches from the floor, use subtly varied but coherent light blue tiles. Show actual depth through four visible inside WALLS, each occupying about 7–8% of the image dimension: narrow waterline at the outside, then a tiled vertical wall going down into a slightly recessed floor; consistent sunlight from upper right and plausible soft darkening at the lower left wall/floor seam, not a black vignette. Keep the floor luminous and clear. Caustics are fine bright gently distorted networks, local variations, no fake milky haze. Natural believable 1.5 meter water depth despite high optical clarity. Empty water, no float rings, no figures, no UI, no text, no clock, no logos. Preserve all side lengths, no tilted camera, no diagonal perspective.

Edit ONLY the pool depth architecture and its shadows in this empty square pool background. Preserve the luminous clear light-aquamarine water, crisp blue ceramic tile material, bright fine caustic refractions and perfectly VERTICAL TOP-DOWN CAMERA. The current pool walls are much too shallow. Make the visible TOP INSIDE WALL 12 percent of the full image height, bottom wall 10 percent, side walls 9 percent of image width; the recessed flat floor occupies approximately central 80 percent. The camera looks straight down from above with a moderately wide lens so the four vertical walls are actually visible and clearly descend into the water, corner seams converge symmetrically inward toward the deeper bottom. Show five to seven rows of real blue mosaic tiles running down the TOP wall, foreshortened near waterline, visually taller toward floor. Crucially the TOP inner wall is a distinct cool dark blue BACKLIT SHADE PLANE, plus a soft natural cast shadow spreads 5–7 percent farther down onto the floor below the TOP wall, strongest in upper-left; the change of plane at its foot must be unmistakable. Also dark wall-floor contact occlusion on sides, plausible upper-right sun direction. Walls and wall shadows convey substantial 1.8–2 meter depth, not dark water. Central water remains clear bright pale turquoise and transparent with tile details fully visible, no deep navy floor, no murky haze or dark vignette. Keep realistic sunlight/corner geometry and smooth shadow falloff. No figures, no rings, no items, no UI, no text, no numbers, no logos.
